爱莎贝儿新品发布-140CM-M 粉肤 AHR037 浅羽夏子Asawa Natsuko-比糖果甜蜜的告白
亮闪闪的眼睛里，映着你的倒影——那是她全部的世界。
她像一颗裹着彩色糖纸的糖果，外表甜美柔软，内里却藏着一颗随时会融化的心。
“爱不爱我？”这四个字在她舌尖翻滚了千百遍，她问得小心翼翼，那句藏在心底的表白是比所有糖果都珍贵的惊喜。
如果你也看见她瞳孔里闪烁的星光，请接住那颗摇摇欲坠的糖果，让所有忐忑都化成绕指柔的糖丝。
身型：140CM-M 粉肤涂装

Elsa Babe New Doll Release-140CM-M Pink AHR037 Asawa Natsuko-A Confession Sweeter Than Candy
Her sparkling eyes reflect your image—that's her whole world.
She's like a candy wrapped in colorful paper, sweet and soft on the outside, but inside lies a heart that could melt at any moment.
"Do you love me?" These four words have rolled on her tongue a thousand times. She asks them cautiously, that confession hidden in her heart is a surprise more precious than any candy.
If you also see the starlight twinkling in her pupils, please catch that trembling candy, let all your anxieties melt into soft, sweet threads.
Body type: 140CM-M with Pink skin tone and body paint.
